commit.subject: LU-10026 csdc: compress_request memory optimisation
commit.message:
LU-10026 csdc: compress_request memory optimisation

Map brw pages with vm_map_ram instead of copying them to a
buffer allocated by sptlrpc_pool_get_pages. This should save
memory and some CPU cycles.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
DDN-bug-id: EX-10553
